_category_note: No IR category is a perfect fit for a bespoke icon-hero accent (calendar + warning badge). Closest schema shape is kinetic-type's scenes[]; text is minimal and the icon is the hero, per the brief.
style: Minimal icon-first accent piece. Clean hand-drawn line-art calendar icon in purple/black brand system, one date cell flags with a warning badge, short bright-accent label beneath. Ties to script line ~00:22 'one slow month away from a real problem.'

customize.note: Hand-authored per Director brief (bespoke icon concept expected). Reused motion-vocabulary primitives: scale_punch (back.out(2.2)) for badge pop, shake keyframes for urgency, glow (textShadow/boxShadow yoyo) for emphasis, stroke-draw (strokeDashoffset) for icon line-art reveal — same recipes as svg-stroke-trace / badge-pop catalog components, hand-tuned to the custom calendar geometry rather than installed verbatim.

scenes.motion: bg-fill fades in (0.1-0.25s); calendar line-art draws in via stroke-dashoffset on body/rings/header-divider (0.15-0.75s, power2.out), grid cells scale+fade in with a short stagger (0.45-0.85s, back.out)

flagged date cell pulses accent-bright (1.0-1.4s, sine.inOut yoyo); warning badge (circle + triangle/exclamation, #B5675C) pops onto that cell (1.6s, back.out(2.2)) with a glow (textShadow/boxShadow yoyo) and a brief shake (1.9-2.0s, keyframes x:-6/6/0)
label fades + lifts in beneath the icon (2.6-3.1s, power2.out), full stack holds static to 4.5s
freeze-hold, no new tweens, clean cut point for host footage
